# Embers rising from the lava pool: 8 copies of one 1 m field of 4 embers, copy k raised k m and
# turned k x 137.5 degrees; the object rises 1 m and turns 137.5 degrees per 1.5 s, so each copy
# takes the next one's place (seamless, and a golden-angle helix does not read as a repeat). The lowest
# copy starts under the pool surface, inside the island's rock; the top one leaves the frame. Pool
# centre at the origin. Generated by make_env.py.
new
fps 12
frame range 0 18
material new Ember --base-color 1.000 0.557 0.502 --emission 1.000 0.557 0.502 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name E0_0 --size 0.09 --location 0.147 0.290 -0.205
add mesh cube --name E1_0 --size 0.09 --location -0.041 0.532 -0.351
add mesh cube --name E2_0 --size 0.09 --location -0.037 -0.304 -0.456
add mesh cube --name E3_0 --size 0.09 --location 0.089 -0.584 -0.783
add mesh cube --name E0_1 --size 0.09 --location -0.305 -0.114 0.795
add mesh cube --name E1_1 --size 0.09 --location -0.329 -0.420 0.649
add mesh cube --name E2_1 --size 0.09 --location 0.233 0.199 0.544
add mesh cube --name E3_1 --size 0.09 --location 0.329 0.491 0.217
add mesh cube --name E0_2 --size 0.09 --location 0.302 -0.122 1.795
add mesh cube --name E1_2 --size 0.09 --location 0.526 0.087 1.649
add mesh cube --name E2_2 --size 0.09 --location -0.306 0.010 1.544
add mesh cube --name E3_2 --size 0.09 --location -0.574 -0.139 1.217
add mesh cube --name E0_3 --size 0.09 --location -0.140 0.294 2.795
add mesh cube --name E1_3 --size 0.09 --location -0.447 0.291 2.649
add mesh cube --name E2_3 --size 0.09 --location 0.219 -0.215 2.544
add mesh cube --name E3_3 --size 0.09 --location 0.518 -0.285 2.217
add mesh cube --name E0_4 --size 0.09 --location -0.095 -0.311 3.795
add mesh cube --name E1_4 --size 0.09 --location 0.133 -0.517 3.649
add mesh cube --name E2_4 --size 0.09 --location -0.016 0.306 3.544
add mesh cube --name E3_4 --size 0.09 --location -0.189 0.560 3.217
add mesh cube --name E0_5 --size 0.09 --location 0.280 0.165 4.795
add mesh cube --name E1_5 --size 0.09 --location 0.251 0.471 4.649
add mesh cube --name E2_5 --size 0.09 --location -0.195 -0.237 4.544

add mesh cube --name E0_6 --size 0.09 --location -0.318 0.067 5.795

add mesh cube --name E3_7 --size 0.09 --location -0.559 0.191 6.217
select E0_0 E1_0 E2_0 E3_0 E0_1 E1_1 E2_1 E3_1 E0_2 E1_2 E2_2 E3_2 E0_3 E1_3 E2_3 E3_3 E0_4 E1_4 E2_4 E3_4 E0_5 E1_5 E2_5 E3_5 E0_6 E1_6 E2_6 E3_6 E0_7 E1_7 E2_7 E3_7
active E0_0
join
rename E0_0 Embers
material assign Ember
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels loc,rot --frame 0
set location 0 0 1.0
set rotation 0 0 137.5
keyframe insert --channels loc,rot --frame 18
keyframe interpolation linear --all
frame set 0
export embers.glb --bake-animations
